test_title: PYST 1: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The report, which the internal auditor had insisted (1)/ should have been submitted before the board meeting, (2)/ were eventually uploaded (3)/ two hours after the deadline. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is a subject-verb agreement error involving the verb "**were**."
 
• The main subject of the sentence is "**The report**," which is a singular noun. The clause "*which the internal auditor had insisted should have been submitted before the board meeting*" is just additional information modifying the subject.
 
• A singular subject requires a singular verb. Therefore, the plural verb "were" must be replaced with the singular verb "**was**" to ensure grammatical correctness.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The report, which the internal auditor had insisted should have been submitted before the board meeting, **was eventually uploaded** two hours after the deadline."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "The report, which the internal auditor had insisted" **– This part of the sentence correctly introduces the subject and the dependent clause.
 
• **2: "should have been submitted before the board meeting,"** – This part correctly maintains the past perfect tense for an action expected in the past.
 
• **4: "two hours after the deadline."** – This part correctly functions as an adverbial phrase of time.
